steps.title: Eligibility
in: Ticket input: the merged story (or the technical ticket), with its criteria
User flow input: the user flow to verify, with its expected steps
Criteria input: the criteria of a need entry, to reproduce a reported defect
If the Recette comes from a report: its steps and the version where the defect was seen
Environment deployed from main, and its version
out: The deployed version contains the story's merge, tasks included (or, for a report, the version where the defect was seen or a newer one), the environment is healthy, the persona exists, the executor is allowed: human required if a criterion is marked by: human

steps.title: Plan preparer
in: The ticket's criteria. Or the user flow's expected steps
out: Test plan: one case per criterion or step, with the observable expectation and the persona's own way of playing it

steps.title: Code checks
out: Each case tied to its source, observable expectation, no case without a source, no criterion without a case

steps.title: Judge
steps.actor: AI, two fixed questions, citation required

questions.q: Does each case express its criterion, no more, no less?
Does the persona change the way of playing without changing the expectation?

out: Yes or no: does each case express its criterion, no more, no less? does the persona change the way of playing without changing the expectation?

steps.title: AI execution
steps.actor: If the executor is the AI: a replayer in a browser, on the environment
out: Result per case: ok or ko

steps.title: Guided execution
steps.actor: If the executor is human: human F or T, guided by an AI

agents.when: guides the human case by case

in: Test plan, presented case by case
out: Result per case: ok or ko, with comment
Its verdict is the validation: it also settles the hypotheses at the end of the session. No gate afterwards

steps.title: Case file
in: Proofs, or the human executor's comments
out: One-page case file: a result and a proof or comment per case, tested version, hashes of the reference and of the persona

steps.title: Judge
steps.actor: AI executor only. AI, fixed question, citation required

questions.q: For each case, does the proof show the described behavior?

out: Yes or no: for each case, does the proof show the described behavior?

steps.title: Gate · Validation
steps.actor: AI executor only. Human F (functional ticket, user flow) or human T (technical ticket)
in: Hypotheses declared by the Build, read from the ticket
out: Validated case file. Each hypothesis is accepted or rejected
For a user flow: each gap is qualified, bug or wrong expectation
Or insufficient proof: the Recette is replayed

steps.title: Record
in: The human's verdict: the executor's, or the gate's
out: Appended to the history, never modified: target, version, date, persona (or none), executor, validated_by, result per case, hashes
If ko or hypothesis rejected: correction tickets created by script, referencing the failed criteria. Dependent tickets are marked "on dependency in gap"
If ok: the story is closed by script, and its epic when all its stories are
Gap qualified as wrong expectation, or user flow bug with no matching criterion: entry to reframe (Need workflow)
Hypothesis accepted: recorded in the entry's log (functional ticket) or in the ADR (technical ticket)

contract: A merged story to recette (all its tasks merged), a merged technical ticket, a user flow to verify, or a report qualified "gap": launched by hand.
An environment deployed from main, at a version. For a story, the version must contain the merge of all its tasks. No per-PR preview.

The reference (story, technical ticket, user flow, or criteria of a need entry to reproduce a reported defect), an optional persona, and the executor: human or AI. The person who launches the Recette chooses, with a project-level default.
A Recette record and, if ko, correction tickets.
Human F for a functional ticket or a user flow, human T for a technical ticket.
notes: The environment is deployed from main, at the version that contains the merge. A Recette is therefore always after the merge. A failure finds the code already on main: the fix goes forward, through a ticket.

Recetted: the last record on the criterion is ok and the criterion's hash has not changed. In gap: the last is ko. The date of the last success is read from the history. Nothing is written in the entry.

With an AI executor, the human gate validates the case file. With a human executor, there is no gate: their verdict is the validation. A criterion marked "judgment" requires human execution for that criterion.
The persona steers, it does not change the verdict
For a ticket, a persona decides how to play the criteria. For a user flow, the flow's personas are played. Personas and user flows are created in the Personas and user flows workflow.
Same rules as the others: project default executor, human gate if the executor is the AI.
Every correction ticket is created by a Recette, including for a reported defect. It therefore always has a record behind it: version, executor, proof.
If several tickets are merged before the Recette of one of them, the case file notes the tested version and the correction ticket references the merges concerned.
doc.lede: A Recette verifies on main, by a human or an AI, that a merged story, a merged technical ticket or a user flow behaves as described. It leaves a record, from which the "recetted" and "in gap" marks derive.
